name: Rudolf Hasse
features: fair skin, dark hair, light eyes, square solid face, heavy jaw, powerful build, phlegmatic expression
bio: An Auto Union works driver from 1937 whose one great day was the Belgian Grand Prix at Spa that year — a win over Stuck and the Mercedes team in appalling conditions. Hasse was conscripted in 1939 and died of illness on the Eastern Front in 1942.
